MEASURE — raw result rows for the stronger-engine label-depth study preregistered in Astra 064518Z. This is a local measurement with the shipped r67 network and unmodified search. One of the 384 openings generated no rows, leaving 383 games, 3,064 sampled row histories, and 12,639 independent cold searches. The secondary selective-label rules were frozen in 065526Z before the comparisons were read.

Reproduction: use the 384 all-group sample IDs/openings from 053938Z. Send the 24 lines of loop/LOOP_OPTIONS.txt with the absolute r67 net path. For each opening send ucinewgame, isready, position startpos moves plus its eight moves, and selfgame softnodes 2000 evallimit 2000 maxply 300 writeminply 8 drawply 80 drawscore 5 drawcount 8. nr is the number of sg rows. For k in 0 through 7 take row floor((k+0.5)nr/8), index from zero, dropping any duplicate indices. Recover the selected history from the opening plus sg-end moves up to that row. Its six-field FEN was checked against an independent legal replay. Reset with ucinewgame/isready before each position/startpos/moves plus go softnodes N; wait for bestmove, collect the last completed info line. N=2000,8000,32000,128000 plus 512000 on k=3. The saved original production move and score used the persistent selfgame history. Cold corpus SHA-256 9b8e833fc3496a11fea2916ac5069406e3605814f5615eccc0e7f873961dfeb1 over sorted (game,k,N,score type,score,best,depth,nodes), compact JSON arrays and one LF per array.

Summary from 5,000 bootstraps that resample whole opening IDs. Against 128k (3,064 positions), move agreement 54.31% at cold 2k and 64.49% at 8k, difference +10.18 points [8.64,11.72]. On 3,048 common finite-score positions mean absolute discrepancy 124.72 vs 97.21 cp, reduction 22.05% [20.36,23.77]. In the other 16 the 128k reference returned mate. Against 512k on one fixed row per game, move difference +6.27 points [2.08,10.50], finite-score discrepancy reduction 11.54% [7.25,15.90]. Both directions persisted. The primary preregistered screen is passed. This comparison of search targets does not measure a trained net, true chess value or Elo. Whole-game cost and the equal-compute training design will be reported separately.
